scripts.preinstall: sh -c 'rm -f package-lock.json yarn.lock; case "$npm_config_user_agent" in pnpm/*) ;; *) echo "Use pnpm instead" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac'
scripts.dev: pnpm run db:deploy && pnpm run db:bootstrap && pnpm -r --parallel --filter @workspace/api-server --filter @workspace/peppol-flow run dev
scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run db:generate && pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
